title.narrative: Comprehensive and sustainable social protection for all

description.narrative: The ILO produces the World Social Protection Report as one of its flagship reports produced every two years. It is a regular and essential resource for policy makers, researchers and practitioners. It provides a comprehensive overview of recent developments in social protection systems worldwide. During this biennium, a regional compendium report to the ILO World Social Protection Report 2024–25, highlighting key social protection developments, challenges and priorities for the Asia-Pacific region is to be produced. In additionm ILO collaborates with UN agencies to analyse the challenges to achieve universal social protection by 2030 in countries across Asia-Pacific.
